response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced full-stack/backend software engineer with broad language exposure (TypeScript, D, JavaScript, Java, C#), but he lacks the core requirements for this role: no substantive recent C++ development, no Windows-platform experience, no SQL Server/Oracle expertise, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure. A brief C/C++ stint in 2014-2015 at National Instruments is over a decade old and not on Windows-focused capital markets systems.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse professional software development experience
Strong generalist engineering skills with CI/CD, testing, and cloud/Kubernetes exposure
Fluent English communicator with teaching/workshop experience
concerns: No meaningful recent C++ experience (last C/C++ work was ~2014-2015, not Windows-focused)
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience anywhere in work history
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; only lists generic SQL/MongoDB/MySQL

key_factors.factor: Lack of C++ depth and recency
No capital markets/fixed income domain experience
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows platform experience
